integration.proxyConfigYaml:
# ui5.yaml: Cấu hình Proxy Middleware giải quyết CORS
server:
  customMiddleware:
    - name: fiori-tools-proxy
      afterMiddleware: compression
      configuration:
        ignoreCertError: true
        backend:
          - path: /sap
            url: http://s4h2025.corp.internal:8000
            client: '100'
        ui5:
          path:
            - /resources
            - /test-resources
          url: https://ui5.sap.com

testing.abapUnitCode:
" ABAP Unit Test cho RAP Business Object ZI_DemoHeaderTP
CLASS ltcl_demo_header_test DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING
  DURATION SHORT
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: mo_environment TYPE REF TO if_cds_test_environment.
    CLASS-METHODS: class_setup, class_teardown.
    METHODS: test_validation_status_code FOR TESTING,
             test_action_approve FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_demo_header_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_setup.
    mo_environment = cl_cds_test_environment=>create( 'ZI_DEMOHEADERTP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD class_teardown.
    mo_environment->destroy( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_validation_status_code.
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF ZI_DemoHeaderTP
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      CREATE FIELDS ( DemoCode StatusCode )
      WITH VALUE #( ( %cid = 'ROOT_01' DemoCode = 'INVALID_01' StatusCode = 'XX' ) )
      FAILED DATA(lt_failed)
      REPORTED DATA(lt_reported).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_failed-demoheader ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_action_approve.
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF ZI_DemoHeaderTP
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      EXECUTE approve FROM VALUE #( ( HeaderUUID = '00000000000000000000000000000001' ) )
      RESULT DATA(lt_result)
      FAILED DATA(lt_failed).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_failed-demoheader ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
